story: 'Sesame Street': from radical experiment to beloved TV mainstay
text: Philip Glass scored an animation for Sesame Street. [VIDEO] I blame this for my interest in modern classical. I can't imagine them doing something so progressive today. But that's because they had a captive audience in the 70's.

story: Caroll Spinney Leaves ‘Sesame Street’ After Nearly 50 Years
text: Sesame Street had so many great creative and musical segments before it turned into the Elmo show. It didn't talk down to children or insult their intelligence. It inspired children rather than just try to hypnotize them with colors and repetition to shut them up for an hour. [LINK] [VIDEO] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK]
